events.text: I stand on the outdoor pathway and look around at the lush green bushes, trees, and the exterior of a nearby restroom building.
I look down at my hands and manipulate a thin elastic rubber band, stretching and looping it around my fingers.
I hold and manipulate a thin string with both hands while looking down at the pavement.
I lower my hands and look forward along the paved walkway toward the park restroom building and the lamppost.
I look ahead down the path as two pedestrians walk out from the shelter area toward me.
A passerby says "刚刚刚刚那时候" while walking past me.
I watch the second pedestrian in the striped shirt walk past me on the right.
I stand on a paved park pathway next to a public restroom building, looking forward along the path.
I look down at my hands and pick at my fingers.
I look up toward the restroom building wall as two pedestrians approach in the distance.
I look back down at my hands and continue picking at my fingers.
I look up to watch the two pedestrians walk past me, then gaze further down the path at a person standing near the female restroom entrance.
I look toward the person standing on the path and ask '什么？'.
I walk along a paved brick path in a park next to a public restroom structure.
I say '不能，在那边呢，不过可以去看一下。' to my companion while continuing along the path.
I say '这我不，这我很喜欢，' as I glance across the gravel garden bed and trees.
I say '咱就喜欢这种地儿。' as I walk past the companion along the curve.
My companion replies '就喜欢养老的地儿。' while I adjust my grey sun sleeves with both hands.
I walk forward along the curved brick walkway toward the open shelter pavilion.
I say '那不是少走弯路吗？' while walking toward the pavilion.
I turn slightly left along the path, passing a white botanical signpost and looking towards the illuminated park garden.
I say '我操这个灯很神呐，虽然是驱蚊的，' while looking up at the illuminated tall pole lamp.
I say '但是这紫色怎么感觉，跟这公园很' as I walk past the pole and focus on a small purple-lit insect-killing post lamp among the trees.
I say '神奇啊'.
I say '从来没见过紫色的灯'.
I walk across the illuminated paved terrace toward the wide tree-lined path.
I continue walking forward toward the staircase opening as my companion in a white cap walks alongside me.
I say '好看'.
I look up at the wide stone staircase flanked by trees and warm lampposts.
I say '我操'.
I walk to the base of the wide stone staircase as a person pushes a blue shared bicycle down the steps.
I look down at the blue shared bicycle as the person pushes it past me on the landing.
I walk up the wide stone stairs following my companion in the white cap as another cyclist descends.
I walk up the outdoor stairs following my companion while glancing at a person pushing a bicycle.
My companion walking ahead turns slightly and speaks to me.
I follow my companion up the second flight of stairs and reach the wide paved walkway.
I reply to my companion while walking along the path.
I glance over to the landscaped garden area on the left featuring stone lanterns and garden features.
I ask '干嘛？' as I walk.
I continue walking along the long, straight tree-canopied promenade.
I question '这能出？' while looking toward the side.
I walk alongside my companion, who is walking on my right side.
My companion laughs and speaks beside me.
I look at the wooden park bench along the edge of the path as we walk past.
I walk forward along the paved park walkway illuminated by streetlights.
I ask my companion '徐老师去台湾，和他女朋友吗？' while continuing to walk forward.
I continue walking forward past a wooden bench on my left toward an upcoming path junction.
I ask '他也是结课了是吧？' as my companion walks beside me on the right.
I look ahead at the metal staircase rising into the park foliage.
I say '可以啊' while turning slightly toward the right-hand path.
I turn right onto a curving pathway illuminated by low bollard lights.
I walk along the curving walkway as my companion speaks: '从你学的太好太好使了。'
I walk along a curving paved path flanked by illuminated bollard lights and dense foliage.
I say '咱也是学会了。'
I walk forward along the path towards a widening fork, passing my companion on my right.
I say '咱也是，咱也是学会举一反三了。'
I walk across the tiled plaza toward a fenced-off decorative floral display adorned with lights.
I say '真是活到老学到老。'
I walk alongside the metal perimeter barrier, observing the glowing heart shapes and miniature Ferris wheel in the garden bed.
I look across the paved outdoor plaza and landscaped garden beds next to my companion wearing a white cap.
I say "谈恋爱的声音".
I walk forward along the paved main pathway lined with tall trees and street lamps.
I approach a fork where a narrower brick path branches off beside a large banyan tree with aerial roots.
I say "好喜欢这个小道啊".
I say "走一下这个".
I turn onto the winding brick garden path lit by glowing bollard lights.
I walk along a curved brick pathway in a park garden at dusk.
I look toward the green garden sign reading '香草园' as my companion speaks.
I continue walking forward along the curving brick path past an intersection.
I say '从百草园' while continuing down the walkway.
I follow my companion along the path as they appear ahead wearing a white cap.
My companion turns slightly to ask a question.
I continue following the path as it bends along the hillside garden.
I say 'Surprise,'.
I say 'motherfucker.'.
I walk forward as my companion turns around and walks past me.
I walk along the ascending brick path enjoying the evening view.
I walk along an outdoor paved garden path at dusk, looking at the trees and distant landscape.
I say '你说的对' to my companion.
I glance forward towards the tree trunk and shrubs along the path.
I say '你说的对'.
I walk along the brick pathway following my companion walking ahead.
I say '这么多果子都掉到地上了，小鸟竟然不来吃' while looking down at the ground and plants beside the path.
I continue walking behind my companion, looking down along the paved walkway.
I say '哦，好吧'.
I follow my companion along the curving pathway around a circular garden planter.
I walk along a curved paved brick pathway in a park at dusk, following a companion walking ahead of me.
I continue walking forward as the path connects into a wide tree-lined promenade.
I say "好像草坪离那儿那么近。" while glancing toward the trees and park sign on the right.
I gaze ahead along the promenade toward people seated near the lawn area under the trees.
I ask my companion "去踩踩吗？" as we walk along the promenade.
I look at a large banyan tree growing through a wooden deck on the left, then gaze at the spiral lookout tower in the distance.
I look at the garden bed sign and follow my companion walking ahead along the wooden deck walkway.
I step down onto the green artificial turf strip and walk along the lane behind my companion towards the spiral lookout tower.
I say '其实我说花艺，你们也都能听懂。' while walking along the path.
I continue walking forward down the green turf path towards the open plaza area.
My companion says '我听不懂，我以为你说的是那个艺术的。' as she steps to the right.
I walk to the end of the turf lane and step onto the connecting wooden boardwalk path leading to the brick promenade.
I step down from the wooden deck onto the paved park walkway and look forward across the pond.
I say "好家伙，逛完了你说真不错。那可不得逛完了才发出感慨呢。" while walking along the path.
I gaze across the pond toward the illuminated spiral tower structure.
I ask "咱们转上去吗？" to my companion.
I extend my left hand and point towards the tower across the pond while continuing to walk.
I walk forward along the stone walkway following other visitors past wooden park benches.
I say "咋就能使一次呢？" while continuing to walk.
I walk along the paved path bordering the pond edge and landscaped garden beds.
I say "那你咋能一直使呢？" to my companion walking beside me.
I continue walking forward along the illuminated park path toward an illuminated pergola structure.
I walk along the tiled waterfront promenade past garden arches and a shallow reflection pond.
I look down at an informational signpost introducing the Hong Kong Reunification Monument (香港回歸紀念塔) beside the pond.
I look up and walk across the open plaza towards the waterfront railing where people are exercising.
I say '咱也去加入他们。' to my companion while walking towards the group stretching by the railing.
I say '我也去加一个，然后你帮我们四个拍张照。' as I continue walking forward across the plaza.
I walk across the wide plaza toward the waterfront edge and the yellow trash bin beside the railing.
I walk under the elevated wooden bridge toward the outdoor seating area with parasols and tables.
I walk out from under an elevated wooden architectural structure onto an open paved plaza.
I say "干嘛？" while looking toward the tree planter and promenade ahead.
I walk past the circular tree planter toward the footbridge leading to the seaside promenade.
I ask "来的时候就走这条路？" while looking at the footbridge path ahead.
I walk along the footbridge beside the pond toward the coastal promenade lined with palm trees and streetlights.
My companion turns and says "你礼貌吗？我礼貌吗？你不礼貌啊？我礼貌吗？" while holding a phone as we walk.
I stand near the top of an outdoor seaside staircase and look at my companion raising a smartphone to frame a photo.
My companion speaks to me, saying '你在'.
I watch my companion frame and capture photos with their smartphone, then lower the phone to review the captured image.
I shift my gaze away from my companion and look down toward the steps ahead.
I walk down the tiled staircase toward the waterfront plaza.
I say '胸的' while stepping down the stairs.
I continue walking down the steps, glancing at the ground text marking the inclusive pet park boundary beside the stone pillars.
I walk along the tiled waterfront promenade while listening to my companion speak.
I continue walking forward across the promenade plaza.
I ask '啥时候去？' while continuing to walk forward.
I ask '今天就去？上完课了？' as I walk toward the waterfront railing.
I walk toward the metal guardrails at the top of the stairwell.
I say '哦。' as I approach the edge of the stairs.
I walk down the short flight of concrete steps.
I step onto the lower asphalt walkway as a cyclist rides past.
I ask '顺德在哪？' while looking at the parked pedal cart.
I walk past the parked surrey carts and say '哦，广东是吧？'.
I continue walking along the seaside path beside the tower's white support pillars.
I stand under a white shelter pavilion on a seaside promenade cycling path and watch a cyclist ride past along the waterfront railing.
I listen as my companion beside me speaks about what I am doing.
I watch my companion walk ahead on the promenade as she continues speaking.
I walk forward along the path following my companion towards our parked bicycles near a ramp under the directional signpost to Tai Po Town Centre.
I say '我只会跟你学，你教得好' to my companion as I approach the parked bicycles.
I listen as my companion turns back and asks me a question.
I stand by my bicycle as my companion walks back over to her bike under the Tai Po Town Centre signpost.
I hold my white power bank and charging cable while watching my companion retrieve her grey backpack from the bicycle.
I look across the reservoir and turn towards my companion by our bicycles, saying '咱这就是鹦鹉学舌'.
I look at my companion as she takes a drink from her water bottle.
I ask my companion for her phone, saying '手机给我'.
I look down at the bicycle while my companion prepares to hand me her phone.
I hold and unfold a paper bicycle rental receipt with both hands while my companion offers her phone.
I take the iPhone with my right hand while holding the receipt in my left hand, then activate Spotlight search to look for Google Maps.
I open Google Maps and tell my companion '拍一下吧' while holding the receipt and phone together.
I examine the bicycle rental rules and return map on the back of the paper slip while comparing it with Google Maps on the phone.
My companion leans down and asks '这个字念啥呀' while I keep looking at the rental instructions.
I look down at the printed bicycle rental slip and map in my left hand while holding my phone displaying Google Maps in my right hand.
I look up at my companion and the surrounding area while asking about the bicycle shop's name.
I look closely at the printed rental slip showing '本車應於租用當日下午7:00前交回' as my companion leans in to inspect it with me.
I listen to my companion while holding up my phone with both hands to search.
I type '世运单车' into the search box on Google Maps on my phone.
I examine the Google Maps search results displaying the business listing for '世运单车' showing '即将结束营业 · 19:00'.
I inform my companion that the shop closes in seven minutes while looking at the Google Maps listing for '世运单车'.
I continue checking the map route and location on Google Maps on my phone as my companion handles the backpack.
The companion asks me '点啊' while I view search results for '世运单车' on Google Maps on my phone.
I select '世运单车行' and browse route directions on Google Maps, checking public transit options (K18, 71A bus) and switching to walking mode.
I examine the walking route to '世运单车行' on Google Maps showing a 29-minute walk (2.1 km).
I say '牛摸的' while viewing the 29-minute walking route to '世运单车行' on Google Maps.
I pick up and unfold the bicycle rental slip with my left hand to read the return instructions.
I ask '哪有电话呀？' while searching for a contact number on the paper receipt.
I flip the receipt over to read the rental details and printed shop phone numbers.
My companion asks '没有吗？'.
I compare the phone numbers on the rental slip with the Google Maps route on my phone.
I hold a paper bike rental receipt in my left hand and view a location route on my smartphone in my right hand.
I say '指点，指点，指点' while examining the map card for '世运单车行' on my phone.
I tap on the '致电' (Call) button on the shop's information card in the map app.
I say '恒康' as the outgoing call screen connects.
My companion reaches over with her hand to take the phone as it dials.
My companion speaks on the phone, saying '我们现在过去要多久？十分钟。'
I watch my companion turn around towards the path while continuing the phone call.
I look down at the bike rental receipt and fold it with both hands.
I tuck the receipt away and reach down to adjust the bicycle saddle and frame.
I look up at my companion and say 'OK，OK。'
I hold my bicycle while standing on an outdoor paved path next to my companion and their bicycle.
I look up at my companion holding a smartphone and say '导航'.
I look at my iPhone screen showing Google Maps place details for '世運單車行' and a 29-minute walking route preview before tapping the blue '开始' button.
I view the active turn-by-turn navigation on Google Maps, examining the map route.
I look down at the navigation screen and exclaim '我操'.
I look up ahead at the illuminated pathway, the palm trees, and my companion waiting on the bicycle.
I hold my phone in my right hand, look at the screen, and say '我怎么给锁了？你妈的。'
I look up at the directional signs and my companion standing with her bicycle.
I look at my companion and say '先沿着这个海边骑。'
I look at the map navigation route on my phone screen showing '向西南前行' and place the phone into the front basket.
I grip both handlebars and begin pedaling forward, turning onto the waterfront cycling path.
I ask '点心？哪有点心？' while cycling forward.
I continue pedaling forward along the path toward the coastal bike track entrance.
I listen as my companion says '这边。' guiding the way onto the cycling track.
I steer my bicycle between the bollards onto the green-surfaced coastal cycling track.
I cycle along the waterfront path and say '哎有劲儿嘞，你别说。'
I continue riding steadily along the cycling track next to the water.
I listen as my companion asks '咋有劲儿啊？'
I look ahead down the open waterfront bike lane.
I say '刚才这一逛，给我逛兴奋嘞。' as I ride forward along the seaside track.
I continue cycling smoothly along the illuminated waterfront bike path.
I ride my bicycle forward along the paved riverside bike lane at dusk.
I say "这个晚风" while riding along the riverside promenade.
I continue cycling forward as an oncoming cyclist in a white shirt passes by on my right.
I cycle forward along the path, looking down at water puddles on the asphalt surface.
I steer along the path as another cyclist on a blue shared bicycle rides past in the opposite direction.
I cycle forward, looking out across the open water at the lit buildings across the shore.
I say "好爽啊这块" as I pedal smoothly along the waterfront stretch.
I continue riding forward along the straight path beside the illuminated park wall.
I ride past a stationary bicycle parked against the guardrail on my left.
I cycle along a paved riverside bike path while looking ahead at the path and the river.
I say "啊，不是，也不是。" while continuing to ride along the path.
I hold up my smartphone with my right hand to check the navigation map while steering with my left hand.
I check the navigation instructions on the phone screen displaying "向右转 600米" and remaining trip info "26 分钟 1.9 公里".
I say "哦，是。" while lowering the smartphone.
I say "是。" as I focus my gaze back on the bike path ahead.
I ride toward a painted road warning sign marking on the cycling path.
I say "执行。" as I approach a path intersection.
I cycle forward through the path junction toward a bridge underpass, passing pedestrians on the left sidewalk.
I ride my bicycle forward along the riverside cycling path towards the underpass of a bridge.
I ride under the bridge through the dark underpass, watching the cyclist and pedestrians ahead.
I exit the underpass and follow behind a cyclist wearing a jersey with the number 25.
I look down towards my bicycle handlebars and front basket before refocusing on the path ahead.
I continue cycling along the paved path between the tree canopy on the right and the promenade on the left.
I glance upward and to the left across the river towards the illuminated residential apartment buildings.
I look back at the bike path ahead and continue riding forward as an oncoming cyclist approaches in the opposite lane.
I ride my bicycle along the paved riverside cycle path, approaching an overpass.
I say 'Goodbye my friend, it's hard to die.' while holding up my smartphone to check the '向右转 300米' navigation instruction.
I glance down at the navigation map on my phone showing '向右转 300米' and '22分钟' while riding.
I ride under the bridge overpass, looking ahead down the illuminated cycling lane.
I glance left at people standing beside shared bicycles under the bridge.
I ride out from under the bridge along the open riverside path, following behind other cyclists.
Another cyclist rides past on the left as a companion exclaims '哇，这个好漂亮！'.
I look out across the river toward the twilight sky and skyline.
I say '觉得好漂亮啊。' while continuing to ride along the riverside path.
I look ahead at the jogger running along the riverbank path.
I walk forward along the riverside promenade, looking ahead at the river, trees, and distant high-rise buildings at dusk.
I say '这段好漂亮啊' while looking ahead along the path.
I continue walking along the path, shifting my gaze down toward the lane markings and the path ahead.
My companion says '薄暮冥冥之际' in response.
I continue walking forward along the promenade, observing the curving tree branches, the calm river surface, and distant city lights.
I ride my bicycle forward along the red paved cycling track next to the river promenade.
I slow my bicycle down as I approach a pathway junction with yellow flexible bollards and take out my phone.
I tell my companion ahead to stop and go up as I brake.
I come to a stop on the cycle track while holding both handlebars.
I hold my phone with both hands and examine the navigation route showing '稍向左转 200米' towards Lam Tsuen River.
I tell my companion to go up while panning the map along Lam Tsuen River.
I clarify the direction to my companion, instructing to turn left after going up, while checking the '稍向左转' marker.
I finish checking the route on my phone as the companion begins pedaling forward ahead.
I ride my bicycle along the red-paved cycle path beside the waterfront promenade, steering around a gentle curve.
I steer left around the bend onto the ramp path beside the stone wall, glancing past the multi-destination directional signpost.
I continue cycling up the incline, looking toward the '迎全運 大埔區龍舟競賽' banner attached to the left railing.
I ride steadily along the bike lane separated by yellow delineator posts from the pedestrian walkway.
I look down at the painted '慢駛 / SLOW' markings on the cycle track pavement.
I ride my bicycle forward along the marked bike lane next to a stone wall.
I say "你不能挡我一条小线儿啊" as a companion on a bicycle cuts ahead across my lane.
I continue pedaling along the cycle track towards the open intersection and bridge ramp.
I say "左拐" as I turn left onto the bridge bicycle path.
I ride straight across the bridge along the cycle path, following behind the other cyclist.
I cycle forward along a designated asphalt bike path flanked by a pedestrian sidewalk on the left and a road with a white metal guardrail on the right.
I say "Yes." while continuing to cycle forward.
I continue cycling along the bike path as a red double-decker bus travels alongside on the adjacent road.
I ride along the curve of the cycling track, looking ahead past the road marking painted on the ground.
I cycle past two oncoming cyclists riding along the opposite side of the track near a sheltered bus stop.
I continue riding along the bike path as it enters a section bordered on the left by red and white plastic water-filled construction barriers.
I raise my smartphone in my right hand to check the navigation route showing '稍向左转' (Slight left turn in 70m/50m) while steering with my left hand.
I look ahead down the path while continuing to cycle alongside the water barriers.
I ride my bicycle forward along an outdoor asphalt bike path at dusk.
I hold up my smartphone in my right hand and check the map navigation route indicating '稍向左转' (Slight left turn) while continuing to cycle.
I swipe up from the bottom of my phone screen to open the app switcher, viewing open app cards for Camera and Maps.
I say '啊？' as another cyclist overtakes me on the right while my phone displays the home screen.
I follow behind the cyclist while holding my phone displaying the home screen.
I switch back to the map navigation app showing the updated instruction '向右转 200米'.
I look up at the path ahead approaching a traffic signal intersection while following the cyclist.
I look at the phone app showing the recent call log on my phone.
I swipe to switch apps back toward navigation.
I say '等一下，别急，别急。' while viewing the navigation route indicating an upcoming right turn in 100 meters.
I ride along the curved paved path at dusk, looking down at the road surface markings ahead of me.
